benchmarkNotes: Synthetic DOT cold parse and dependency-tree construction; excludes sbt shell, fixture generation, compilation and SDK startup.
Two runs. Normal cases: one warmup then five samples. Slow legacy 10000-node case: one cold sample and no warmup.
Frozen old expansion implementation and Graphviz parser versus new direct-edge index and linear sbt DOT reader.
